title: Quick Tip: Scammers target gift cards
description: Gift cards are popular gifts, but they are also the target of scammers. ABC7's Jason Knowles and the I-Team has some tip if you're buying or receiving gift cards this holiday season: https://abc7.ws/2EI12fV

asr.full_text: Hi, I'm Jason Knowles with an i-Team Quick Tip. There are several gift card scams out there, so we are alerting you about them because gift cards are a popular gift this holiday season. So if you are buying a gift card, you should make sure you go directly to the vendor and get it behind the register. Then when you get that gift card, look at the back of the card. Make sure the numbers and the pin were not tampered with. Finally, if you are getting a gift card, use it as quickly as possible. There are several scams out there where people are trying to obtain those numbers and spend your money before you do. I'm Jason Knowles for the ABC7i team.
